definitions.explanation: A condition where one perceives sounds such as ringing, buzzing, or humming in the ears without an external source. Can be temporary (from loud noise or pressure changes) or chronic.

examples.japanese: {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have ringing in my ears.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: After the concert, the ringing in my ears wouldn't stop.

examples.japanese: {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ようなら、⟦{耳鼻科|じびか}→耳鼻科：22874_jibika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: If the ringing in your ears continues, you should see an ENT doctor.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (ear) + ⟦{鳴|な}り→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ (ringing, sounding). The verb form is {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have ringing in the ears) — note that it uses ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have ringing in the ears
- {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: the ringing won't stop
- {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: the ringing continues
- {耳鳴|みみな}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment for tinnitus
